risk_summary: The excerpt is heavily weighted toward standard forward-looking disclaimer language and broad, largely unquantified risk factors, limiting visibility into downside scenarios. It does provide meaningful portfolio, capitalization, transaction, and capital expenditure figures, but several critical accounting judgments and impairment assumptions remain dependent on management estimates. Overall tone is neutral to mildly confident, with material exposure to market conditions, capital availability, execution delays, valuation risk, and joint-venture accounting.
